personality_one_liner: A calm, trustworthy, and content-led digital library that feels like a beautifully typeset catalogue.

spacing.rule: Use magazine-like spacing rhythms with generous vertical breathing room. Avoid dense card-heavy layouts.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism entirely for Editorial personality. Rely on solid flat surfaces, generous padding, and typography for hierarchy.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: A visual grid/list of confirmed books in the user's personal library.

states.loading: Skeleton grid with subtle opacity pulses.
states.empty: Illustration/Image of an empty reading chair. 'Your shelves are empty.' + 'Scan a bookshelf' primary CTA.
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Shelfie' in oversized Playfair Display. Clean grid layout for book covers using surfaceSecondary. Each book item shows cover, title, and author. Minimal UI chrome; let the book imagery and typography stand out.

screens.name: Scan
screens.purpose: Camera interface to capture bookshelf photos with real-time feedback.

states.loading: Full-screen solid surfaceInverse overlay with a loading spinner and 'Detecting spines...' text while AI processes the image.
states.error: Error toast overlay if camera permission denied or processing times out.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view. Bottom area uses surface with generous xl padding containing a primary capture button and an 'Upload Photo' secondary action. Avoid heavy UI on top of the camera.

screens.name: Review

states.loading: Spinner in the center of the screen.
states.empty: If no books detected, show a clear message 'We couldn't spot any books' and a 'Retake Photo' button.
states.error: If spine is unreadable or malformed data occurs, highlight the specific book card in warning color and prompt manual entry.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll of detected books. Each card uses surfaceSecondary with generous internal padding (lg). Shows cropped spine image, detected title/author, and confidence badge. Persistent sticky bottom action bar with 'Confirm All' or individual Correct/Discard/Confirm actions. High priority actions are fixed at the bottom.

screens.name: BookDetail
screens.purpose: Displays full information for a single confirmed book.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for cover and text blocks.
states.error: Failed to load book data, retry button.

screens.layout: Full-width hero image of the book cover/spine at the top (with vertical scrim if text overlays, though Editorial prefers text below). Large serif Title and sans-serif Author metadata below the image. Clean, magazine-like typography layout with generous 2xl spacing between sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '3 Editorial Mobile' personality strictly. Use Playfair Display for headings and Satoshi for body text.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. Rely on solid colors from the palette (e.g., surface, surfaceSecondary) and generous whitespace to establish hierarchy.
For the Review screen, implement a persistent sticky bottom action bar (anchored above the safe area) to handle primary Confirm/Correct actions, ensuring they are always within the thumb zone.
Handle error states gracefully as per the design guidelines: Timeouts, 0 books detected, and unreadable spines must have explicit full-screen or card-level error states.

Apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top to bottom, transparent -> 70% surfaceInverse) if placing text over images, though Editorial design prefers placing text beneath the image on a solid surface.
When a single book has low confidence, use the 'warning' color for the confidence badge and ensure the 'Correct' action is highly visible.
